Wat is de subsidie Circular Plastics NL?: What is the Circular Plastics NL subsidy?
Subsidie Circular: De subsidieregeling C: Circular Subsidy: The Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) subsidy scheme is a funding instrument of the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) aimed at accelerating the transition to circular use of plastics in the Netherlands. The scheme supports research and practical projects in the plastics and recycling value chain.

Het onderscheid zit in de fase en schaal: The distinction lies in the phase and scale of the project: research projects focus on knowledge development, while showcase projects focus on demonstrating feasibility at a larger scale in practice.
Wat is het probleem dat CPNL wil oplosse: What problem does CPNL aim to solve?
Kunststof is een van de meest gebruikte: Plastic is one of the most widely used materials in Dutch industry, but its recycling and reuse lag far behind the available technical possibilities. Much plastic still ends up as waste or in low-value applications, even though the value chain can in principle reuse the raw materials. CPNL focuses on closing that gap: from linear use to demonstrably circular applications.

Aanvragen verloopt via RVO. Omdat de reg: Applications are submitted through RVO. Because the scheme requires a collaboration, preparation takes time: parties must form a consortium, align roles and contributions, and jointly submit the application before the deadline.

Als je als bedrijf of instelling werkzaa: If your company or institution operates in the plastics or recycling value chain and is considering a research or showcase project, CPNL is one of the few direct subsidy schemes with a substantial budget per project. The combination of a firm deadline and the collaboration requirement makes it essential to start consortium formation and project definition early.
De deadline van 6 oktober 2026 laat wein: The 6 October 2026 deadline leaves little room for a late start.

Nee. CPNL vereist een samenwerkingsverba: No. CPNL requires a collaboration. An application by a single party is not valid.

De subsidieregeling Circular Plastics NL: The Circular Plastics NL (CPNL) subsidy scheme is a funding instrument of the Netherlands Enterprise Agency (RVO) aimed at accelerating the transition to circular use of plastics in the Netherlands. The scheme supports research and practical projects in the plastics and recycling value chain.
CPNL is open voor partijen actief in de: CPNL is open to parties active in the plastics and recycling value chain. Participation always takes place in a collaboration: an application by a single party is not possible. This can include combinations of companies, knowledge institutions and other organizations in the value chain.
